en.topic_summary:
An elderly woman has been charged with displaying publications with a seditious intention outside her flat in Tin Shui Wai.



West Kowloon Law Courts Building. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Yang Chau-kei, 61, appeared at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Monday for the first mention of her case.
